observations: Two separate sewing machine stands are shown.
The stands have ornate, cast-iron frames with a decorative 'sawtooth' or 'spoked' design.
One stand has a blue painted top surface with a wavy pattern.
The other stand has a brown wood-grain patterned top surface.
A metal ruler is placed on the blue top in photo 2, showing measurements up to 28 inches.
The stands are positioned outdoors on a cracked concrete surface.
Watermarks 'Seshmak Tech' and 'Posted on Jiji' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The items shown are the base frames for sewing machines, commonly called 'legs'.
The value of the item is not shown in the photos.
The location is not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The stands may be missing the sewing machines themselves.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete sewing machine sitting on the stand.

risks.risk: The metal surfaces may be rusted or damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the metal frame and the underside of the tops.

risks.risk: The internal mechanisms (needle bar, presser foot) may be missing or broken.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the machine showing the needle bar and presser foot.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual sewing machines on the stands.
Close-up photo of the metal frame to check for rust.
Photo of the underside of the stands to see the needle bar and presser foot.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as sewing machine stands. They can be priced at their worst-case value (empty stands) until further proof of functionality and completeness is provided.
